description: Defines the SelectableDataGrid class, a UI element for a data grid with row selection and event handling, using the RmlUi library.

classes.name: SelectableDataGrid
classes.description: A UI data grid element with row selection, event handling, and integration with RmlUi.

methods.name: SelectableDataGrid
methods.description: Constructor initializing the data grid with a tag and default selected row.

methods.name: OnChildAdd
methods.description: Handles addition of child elements, adds event listeners for row events.

methods.name: ProcessDefaultAction
methods.description: Processes click and double-click events to select rows and dispatch events.

methods.name: ProcessEvent
methods.description: Handles row removal and addition events to update selection state.
